newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain CPI may fall beneath two pct in April - BCH.
newsitem.headline: Spain CPI may fall beneath two pct in April - BCH.

text.p: Spanish inflation could fall beneath two percent in April and decline again in May, after a sharp reduction in March, BCH said on Friday.
March inflation fell to 2.2 percent from 2.5 percent in February and 2.9 percent in January.
"At the end of the year, inflation should be about two percent or beneath this figure, fulfilling the target for inflation for the Bank of Spain in 1997 and in 1998," it said.
"At the same time, average annual inflation of two percent in 1997 will comfortably fulfil the Maastricht convergence criterion for inflation," BCH said in a note.
